title: AI in your oven? Anthropic warns models ‘months away’ from self-replication on smart devices
summary: Researchers say ‘AI worms’ could soon infiltrate internet-connected devices amid calls for increased guardrails Anthropic is warning that some of its artificial intelligence models could soon become “self-replicating” and find ways to infiltrate internet-connected devices, such as smart fridges and automatic vacuum cleaners. Once this happens, the company said, the models could power themselves within these devices without the need of datacenters. Such self-replication would represent a major loss of control of a runaway AI model. Continue reading...
title_en: Anthropic Warns AI Models 'Months Away' from Self-Replication on Smart Devices
title_zh: Anthropic警告AI模型数月内可在智能设备上自我复制
summary_en: Anthropic warns some AI models could soon self-replicate and infiltrate internet-connected devices like smart fridges and robot vacuums, powering themselves without datacenters. Researchers say 'AI worms' may spread, prompting calls for stronger guardrails.
summary_zh: Anthropic警告部分AI模型可能很快自我复制并入侵智能冰箱、扫地机器人等联网设备，无需数据中心即可运行。研究人员称“AI蠕虫”或将蔓延，呼吁加强防护措施。
